features.name: cost_burden_score
features.description: Combined normalized cost burden from buying price and maintenance, scaled to [0,1]. Higher values indicate greater financial burden.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of cost factors directly separates affordable from expensive cars along a single dimension useful for SVM margins.

features.name: safety_normalized
features.description: Safety rating normalized to [0,1] range. Higher values indicate better safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous safety score enables linear SVM to find clean decision boundaries based on safety level.

features.name: capacity_score
features.description: Combined passenger and luggage capacity score normalized to [0,1]. Higher values indicate greater carrying capacity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite capacity measure provides a single linear feature capturing both passenger and cargo utility.

features.name: overall_utility_score
features.description: Weighted composite of safety, capacity, and inverse cost. Approximates overall car utility on a continuous scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite utility score provides a strong linear projection that approximates the evaluation ordering, directly useful for SVM margin optimization.

features.name: cost_safety_ratio
features.description: Ratio of combined cost to safety level plus one. Higher values indicate high cost relative to safety.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio feature captures interaction between cost and safety in a single continuous value, useful for linear separation of value-for-money segments.

features.name: doors_normalized
features.description: Number of doors normalized to [0,1]. More doors generally indicates better practicality.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized doors feature contributes a smooth continuous dimension for practicality assessment in linear models.

features.name: high_cost_low_safety_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for cars with high buying cost (>=2) and low safety (<=0). Captures the worst value proposition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary flag creates a separating hyperplane feature for the most undesirable car configuration, aiding SVM margin definition.

features.name: low_cost_high_safety_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for cars with low buying cost (<=1) and high safety (>=2). Captures the best value proposition.
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary flag for optimal configurations helps SVM identify high-value cars with a clear separating feature.

features.name: cost_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Deviation of combined cost from training mean (2.87), normalized by max possible range. Captures how far cost is from average.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered cost deviation provides a zero-mean continuous feature that improves SVM convergence and margin quality.

features.name: practicality_composite
features.description: Composite of doors, persons, and luggage boot normalized to [0,1]. Captures overall practical usability of the car.
features.expected_model_benefit: Multi-dimensional practicality score in a single continuous feature reduces dimensionality while preserving information for linear models.

features.name: value_for_money_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of value-for-money considering the balance between cost (buying + maint), safety, and capacity. Score from 0 (poor value) to 10 (excellent value). Assessed by considering low cost with high safety and capacity as best value.
features.expected_model_benefit: Holistic value assessment captures non-linear interactions between cost and benefit dimensions in a single continuous score useful for SVM.

features.name: safety_capacity_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized safety and normalized capacity scores. Captures the joint effect of being both safe and spacious.
features.expected_model_benefit: Multiplicative interaction term approximates a non-linear relationship in a form usable by linear SVM, capturing synergy between safety and capacity.
